reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous
reviews.comment: This monitor is amazing. Should have bought this thing a long time ago. I’m a 53 year old gamer on a PS5 so seeing everything on a smaller screen can be somewhat challenging, especially many of these subtitles and their smaller sizes. This thing is massive, almost as if you’re sitting in a cinema.Every game on this monitor looks amazing, true 4k @ 120 hz…huge difference over my old G5 flat monitor. The curve is perfect. If you’re on the fence, pull the trigger, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.title: Quality Monitor with Unique Screen Size
reviews.comment: The Samsung Odyssey g7 37" is a real quality machine. When I first saw the 37" size I was curious and with there being so little reviews so I took the leap and bought it. I upgraded from a Samsung Odyssey g5 to this one and the upgrade was drastic; the picture quality is top tier, the color accuracy is shockingly good, and the contrast is very good for a non OLED display. The refresh rate is good for me mostly because I game with a console. I do miss the UltraWide 21:9 sometimes but being able to watch most videos without black bars is always a plus and it's a huge monitor so it is not lacking in screen real estate. Overall, It's a very good monitor but the price is definitely what sets it back, I bought mine used- like new- so I saved some money but do not buy it for full price as there are much better OLED alternatives for the around the same price new.
reviews.author: Leon

reviews.title: A software engineer's dream monitor
reviews.comment:
As a software engineer I love having a single large display. It has to have very high resolution, brightness, and ideally a decent refresh rate. I prefer a single display over two monitors because I don't like moving my neck so much throughout the day. For the same reason I'm not a fan of ultra-wides.
Until now I've been using the Gigabyte M32UC - an absolutely fantastic 32" monitor that checks all the boxes above. The only thing I wanted beyond what the Gigabyte offers is a bit more surface area.
Over the past few years I've tried a few other options, but none of them did it all: some were too dark, some had bad refresh rate, some were too wide.
When I saw that Samsung had recently released this one I bought it immediately.
It checks all boxes. The curve is more aggressive than my Gigabyte and I love it. Brightness and refresh rate are great and the resolution is top notch. This is the best monitor I've ever owned and I suspect it will be a long time until one is good enough to replace it.  I wouldn't hesitate for a minute to recommend it.
reviews.author: Armen Shimoon
